title: Big Bang
body:
The **Big Bang** is the model in which the universe began hot and dense and has been expanding
and cooling since. It describes the expansion of space itself, with no explosion into
pre-existing space, so it has no centre and no edge.

The reasoning runs backwards from [[Hubble's Law]]. Everything is moving apart, so
everything was closer together, and extrapolating back gives a moment about 14 billion years
ago when separations approach zero.

Three independent observations support it:

```
expansion            Hubble's Law, in every direction
the microwave sky    the Cosmic Microwave Background, predicted before it was found
element abundances   the ratio of hydrogen to helium matches what fusion in the
                     first few minutes produces, and nothing since has changed it
```

The third is the quantitative one. About 75% hydrogen and 25% helium by mass is what a hot
early universe produces in its first minutes, and stars have altered that only slightly, so the
observed ratio is a measurement of conditions minutes after the beginning.

The model describes the universe from a fraction of a second onward and says nothing about what
came before or what caused it, which is the boundary of the course and of the physics.
